source.name: Valhalla · FOSSGIS e.V. · OpenStreetMap road network
source.methodology: Car travel-time network polygons from specified municipal centroid, snapped to road network; 15, 30 and 60 minutes. Not circles. Default costing with no requested live traffic or departure time.

limitations: 14 precomputed city origins: 13 distinct regional seats (Prague serves two regions) plus Děčín. Polygons apply to the shown origin, never an arbitrary clicked municipality. Public demo rejects contours above 60 minutes; 120 minutes requires an explicitly configured own endpoint. Provider road-graph version is not returned, so exact offline reproduction uses pinned responses; fresh routing may change. Driving estimate is not navigation, live traffic or a guarantee of reachability.
